parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description:
Caller-generated unique key (a UUID per logical submit) that makes a
retried request safe: 1 to 128 printable ASCII characters. Every POST
needs it, in every deployment (the service always runs on Postgres; there
is no in-memory mode). An absent key is a 400 `idempotency-key-required`,
an invalid one (longer than 128 characters or
with a control or non-ASCII character) is a 400 `idempotency-key-invalid`.
A replay with the same key and the same method, path and body returns the
stored response (status, headers and body, including a stored 4xx) with
`Idempotency-Replayed: true`; the same key with a different request is
409 `idempotency-key-reused`. A 5xx outcome is never stored.

parameters.name: planId
parameters.description: The plan id (`plan-` followed by a unique suffix, at most 64 characters).
